data.desc: Trustmark Corporation is a bank holding company headquartered in Jackson, Mississippi, with assets of $19.1 billion as of September 30, 2026. Trustmark Corporation trades on the NASDAQ under the symbol 'TRMK.' Through its wholly owned subsidiaries, Trustmark operates as a financial services organization providing banking and financial solutions to corporate institutions and individual customers through offices in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, Tennessee and Texas.
